s: Bulls i Toy Inc., also styled Bullsitoy, is an American toy company based in Des Moines, Iowa. Beginning in 2016, the company released an assortment of Star Trek "Chibi Figures" as part of the franchise's 50th anniversary licensing expansion. In 2024, the company returned to the license with a small assortment of "Chibi in Motion" products based on Star Trek: Lower Decks.
